findings.explanation: The familiar winter furnishing anchoring the cat–kotatsu–mandarin association becomes an unidiomatic generic appliance.

findings.highlight: it’d be nice to relax in here
findings.evidenceJa: ゴロゴロと居間でくつろいでもバチはあたるまい
findings.governingReading: surely no divine punishment will strike me for lazing around the living room
findings.explanation: Shirou’s mock-justification that relaxing will go unpunished becomes a plain statement that rest would be pleasant.

findings.evidenceJa: よっこいしょ、と座布団に座って
findings.governingReading: With a little “heave-ho,” I settle onto the floor cushion
findings.explanation: The bodily and comic settling-in beat disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: どん、と差し出されたミカン
findings.governingReading: I take two of the mandarins thrust heavily before me
findings.explanation: Taiga’s emphatic presentation of three mandarins disappears before Shirou rejects the quantity.

findings.evidenceJa: ミカンを二つ食べ終わるぐらい
findings.governingReading: at least long enough to finish these two mandarins
findings.explanation: The explicit pair needed for the later joke that Shirou eats a third disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 道場に差し入れにいく
findings.governingReading: go bring her refreshments at the dojo
findings.explanation: The destination and the general act of bringing Saber refreshments are omitted, leaving “some” with an unstable referent.

findings.highlight: I swallow the piece in my mouth
findings.governingReading: I reflexively swallow the mandarin whole
findings.explanation: The startled, unmediated gulp that answers Taiga’s teasing becomes ordinary swallowing.

findings.highlight: I don’t know what she’s doing
findings.evidenceJa: トイレだかなんだか知らないけど
findings.governingReading: Whether she is in the bathroom or wherever
findings.explanation: Shirou’s flustered and deliberately dismissive guess about Rin’s whereabouts is generalized.

findings.highlight: kick her out of the house after that
findings.evidenceJa: 余計なコトする前に家にたたき帰す
findings.governingReading: send her packing before she can do anything unnecessary
findings.explanation: The defensive implication that Shirou must remove Rin before she does something further disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーへの差し入れ
findings.explanation: Mandarins and tea intended specifically for Saber become generic food with no recipient.

findings.evidenceJa: ひょこひょこと居間を後にする
findings.governingReading: bobs jauntily out of the living room
findings.explanation: Taiga’s small comic gait and the room she exits disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 行け行け行ってしまえ
findings.governingReading: Go on, go on—just be gone
findings.explanation: Shirou’s thrice-repeated internal dismissal loses its impatient comic rhythm.

findings.governingReading: silently work my way through the mandarins
findings.explanation: The continuing plural eating that culminates in the third mandarin becomes one fruit.

findings.governingReading: make that hopelessly vacant reflex response
findings.explanation: The joke’s judgment that Shirou’s automatic “yes” is foolishly unguarded disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: だだだだだ、と脱兎の如く縁側に走り去る
findings.governingReading: dada-dada-dada—bolts for the veranda like a rabbit sprung from a trap
findings.explanation: Taiga’s sound-effect rhythm, rabbit simile, and veranda destination collapse into generic speed.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分でもよくわからない言い訳
findings.governingReading: excuses I do not even understand myself
findings.explanation: Shirou’s lack of insight into his own flustered reasoning becomes an external judgment that the excuses are odd.
The text only confirms Rin comes to the living room; “comes back” asserts a return to that location.
